import { Base, Other as O } from './base';
import * as util from "./util";
import Def from './def';

@Injectable()
export class UserService extends Base implements Repo<User>, Named {
  @Input() private readonly repo?: UserRepo;
  static count: number = 0;
  constructor(private api: Api, name: string) { super(); }
  async load(id: string, opts?: Options): Promise<User> {
    const u = new User(id);
    return this.api.fetch(id).then(helper);
  }
}

export interface Named<T> extends Thing {
  name: string;
  child: { deep: Widget };
  greet(who: Person): void;
}

export type Alias = Target;
type Gen = Holder<Widget>;
enum Color { Red, Green = 2 }
export const LIMIT = 10, OTHER = 2;
let counter: Counter;
export function helper(x: Thing): Result { return compute(x); }
export const arrow = async (a: Input): Promise<Output> => transform(a);
